name: Meta Bowling Green data center
summary: Meta data center campus of 715,000 square feet in Middleton Township, Wood County, Ohio, near Bowling Green, announced in April 2025 as an investment of more than USD 800 million and described as optimized for Meta's AI workloads. Meta's location list gives 2025 as the groundbreaking year. In February 2026 the Ohio Power Siting Board approved, without public hearings, a 350 MW behind-the-meter gas plant with about 120 MW of batteries next to the data center, to be built and run by Will-Power OH. Meta names Toledo Edison, FirstEnergy and Williams as energy-planning partners and refers readers to JE Dunn Construction for construction information.

location.note: Township point from OpenStreetMap Nominatim. BG Independent places the adjacent power plant at the northeast corner of Ohio 582 and Mercer Road, but no source gives the data center parcel itself.

notes: The status rests on two undated Meta pages: the U.S. location list, which gives 2025 as the groundbreaking year, and the fact sheet, which describes the data center in the future tense. status_as_of is therefore the date both were read (2026-10-09). The fact sheet PDF shows no publication date; its embedded file creation date is 2026-09-01.

power_sources.description: The Apollo Power Generation Facility, a 350 MW gas plant on 147 acres next to the data center, is approved to serve only the data center with no physical grid connection. Will-Power OH will build and run it, with part of the output expected by mid-2027 and the rest by late 2027.
About 120 MW of battery storage approved as part of the same plant.
Meta says it planned the site's energy needs with Toledo Edison, and names FirstEnergy and Williams as planning partners in its fact sheet; it says it pays the full cost of the energy used.
